restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. Each list word is first tested by an exact packed Y9 prefilter (Lemma PF, 7 units: XOR, ADD, AND, ADD, AND, comparison and branch, each counted): enumeration of condition (1) over all 1024 low-10-bit prefixes leaves 14, all with Y9 bits {0,1,2,6,7,8,9} in {0x004, 0x3c4}, so words with no such lane skip E work losslessly. Before the prefilter, every list word runs the 33-unit low-half Y9 fill (right-shifted low halves of C1.b1 and Y13, which determine bits 0..11 of Y9' exactly); kept words complete the high 12 bits of Y1 and full Y9' in 10 units and run the 3-unit word test (AND, comparison, branch).

The walk (this entry): every member walks seven full blocks of 2^16 steps, s = L0 + 1 to L0 + 7 * 2^16 with t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^19) below 2^19, starting where X0 mod 2^16 is 2^16 - 1 (Lemma W7); on a full block every listed high half names one step, so a live block reads the first copy of its state's list whole in written-out code (Lemma LW): 24 units per live block, 11 per block, no pieces, ranges or partial words. t < 2^51 and both messages are below 2^61 bytes (memory_log2_bytes 63 covers both with the search and SEL).

The member class has 262144 members of each type. Exact E-word counts are 23820160 and 34028800 and each type has 4160 live low-half states; the online source builds both tables and checks these identities. Messages are distinct and the four fixed digest words are checked by the inherited construction. The selection call that fixes the advice record is the one pinned call of proof.md Section 12 (stated binary, seed, instance generator and replay record).

The exact integer ledger, all budgets, power certificate, memory and premises are in the first section of proof.md. N = 62616046669975569648 and log2(N/430) = 57.01497337855212, rounded up to 57.0150 (base entry 4ad5fbe6: 57.1306). RUN_CONTEXTS = 292,392,899,915,096 contexts of 7 * 2^19 steps; WB = 51,355,111,943,085,403,350; W_CTX = 264,771,152; CREDIT = 4,996,119,096,247,707,043. The factors of H4' (1.000173, 1.002882), H_G_cluster (1.000048) and MU = 0.004652 are measured again, preregistered (PLAN6: 2^36 independent walk steps and the declared program on 16,384 whole contexts), because the walk's law changes.

heuristics.statement: The inherited listed-good-trial rate and context-level dependence premise of the fa97a08f construction, unchanged by the typed-list filtering, by the prefilter and by every change of this entry.
heuristics.scope: The same 55/63-byte, flags-3, non-root counter walk and exact solver construction, with the same run length and expected count 0.49594.
heuristics.extrapolation: The rate and dependence are inherited; typed lists and the prefilter only remove impossible words pointwise, and no change of this entry alters which trials are searched.
heuristics.limitations: This remains a heuristic premise, not a theorem.

heuristics.statement: For a walk step of the full-block walk (seven uniform outer words, a uniform member, j uniform below 7 * 2^16), the E-lane and pass counts are at most 1.000173 and 1.002882 times their exact shares, E_COUNT/2^32 per step and 14110208*E_COUNT/2^64 per step, plus a Hoeffding reserve over contexts (range 7 * 2^19 steps).
heuristics.scope: All RUN_STEPS outer steps of the full-block walk.
heuristics.extrapolation: Preregistered PLAN6 Part A, 2^36 independent walk steps with the program's own tables: 462,791,000 typed E steps (0.999999 of the exact share) and 1,520,165 passing steps (0.99984); the lower-tail Chernoff rule at exp(-7) gives the factors.

heuristics.statement: The mean metered debit of the declared program per outer step of the full-block walk (the screen's 64 + 20|T| plus the lane's 15 call-only units plus the executed solver ledger) is at most MU = 0.004652 machine units: the mean of the preregistered PLAN6 Part B run (16,384 whole contexts of the declared program, 0.0043668 per step, standard error 4.748e-05) plus six standard errors, rounded up to 10^-6; the credit adds a Bernstein reserve (L_C = CAPX * 7 * 2^19) and a preflight reserve.
heuristics.scope: The unchanged screen and capped solver on the typed-list walk of seven full blocks per member, over the 2^69.862 outer steps of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: From PLAN6 Part B, 16,384 whole contexts of the declared program (16,384 * 7 * 2^19 = 2^35.807 outer steps, about 2^-34.06 of the run) to the run. The rule (mean plus six standard errors over contexts, rounded up to 10^-6) was written before the run and the whole sample was used: mean 0.0043668 per step, standard error 4.75e-05, MU = 0.004652. No MU scaling.
heuristics.limitations: The debit has a heavy tail (solver calls are rare, one call can debit up to 23151 units), the standard error is a statistical margin and not a proof, the seeds are pseudorandom, and the true mean is not proved. The Bernstein reserve bounds the run total given the mean, not the mean.

heuristics.statement: A block of a walk context is live on average at most 1.000048 times as often as a uniform low half of omega (4,160 of 2^16 for each type), so a context has on average at most that share of its 56 blocks live; the live-block budget adds a Hoeffding reserve over contexts.
heuristics.scope: The 56 full blocks of every context of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: Preregistered PLAN6 Part A: 30,534,464,639 live blocks among the seven of 2^36 independent members, 0.999998 of the model share; the one-sided empirical Bernstein rule at exp(-7) gives the factor.
heuristics.limitations: The live share of a block depends on the outer words and the member, whose law is not proved uniform.

heuristics.statement: For a uniform context, (a) the expected number of list words the exact Y9 prefilter keeps is at most 0.11 times the expected number of list words, and (b) the expected number of listed entries is at least 0.99 times its exact value.
heuristics.scope: The kept-word and kept-lane work budgets of the counter walk; it does not affect the rate, the walk or which trials are found.
heuristics.extrapolation: On this entry's walk (PLAN6 Part B, preregistered, 16,384 whole contexts of the declared program, 57,560,086 list words): kept 0.10462 of the list words (premise 0.11; the budget charges 1/8), and listed entries 0.99480 of their exact count E_COUNT * 7 * 2^19 / 2^32 per context (premise 0.99). Uniform projections would keep 1-(1-2^-6)^7 = 0.1044 of the words. On the base entry's walk the kept share was 0.10459.
heuristics.limitations: A premise on a work count, like H4' and H_G_cluster; if it failed the run would halt and only the success probability would fall.
